name: Keeper Ray

intro.text: Alright, la! Come in, come in, mind the amps. You've got the look of someone who's come all the way from the Peaks.
I'm Ray. I keep the Urban Stone here, and I do the odd drum solo. Mostly the Stone.
Let's see if you can keep time with the city. One, two, three, four!

win: Ey, that was gear! Fab, even. Here, take the Stone before I get all misty.
after: Come back Thursday, we do a lovely set. Bring a mate. Bring two. The club holds forty and there's always sixty.
